page_title: CAG 1-0 ROM | Cagliari v AS Roma 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' A player from AS Roma commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+2' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) replaces Michael Folorunsho.
90+2' The manager makes a subsitution with Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) coming on for Marco Palestra.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Cagliari enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
83' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
82' 1 - 0 Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes into the bottom left corner.
82' Cagliari have a corner.
81' 14:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
78' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
78' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
77' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
77' It will be a substitution. Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) is ready to enter the pitch as Adam Obert walks off.

76' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal! The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
75' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
73' It's time for a substitution. Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) comes on in place of Konstantinos Tsimikas.
71' Fouls committed – 15:11.
69' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Gabriele Zappa and he is replaced by Matteo Prati (Cagliari).
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Gennaro Borrelli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
68' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
68' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes.

65' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Mile Svilar was alert and the score remained the same.
63' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) replacing Lorenzo Pellegrini.
62' Substitution. Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) on for Bryan Cristante.
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) is replacing Matias Soule.

59' Adam Obert (Cagliari) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Mile Svilar to get hold of the ball.
57' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
54' A free kick on the edge of the box for Cagliari. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
53' Here is a change. Tommaso Baldanzi is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
52' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is given his marching orders with a straight red card! For us, it was a very harsh one.
52' The Cagliari players are stunned as referee Luca Zufferli changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
50' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Cagliari, he's going to review using VAR.
50' The referee gives a penalty to Cagliari after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
48' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!

47' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
46' Cagliari will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
46' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' 7:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
40' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Cagliari.
37' Cagliari force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
36' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' Manu Kone (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
33' Adam Obert (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

30' Matias Soule (AS Roma) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom right corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
29' AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.

27' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Mile Svilar is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
25' Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
24' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) tries to find Zeki Celik, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
23' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
22' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) jumps into a tackle and Luca Zufferli signals a foul. Cagliari have a free kick from a promising distance.
21' AS Roma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
20' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 39:61.
18' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

17' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for an infringement. AS Roma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
15' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) is flagged for offside.
13' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle as Marco Palestra (Cagliari) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
8' The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
7' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
6' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

6' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
4' Luca Zufferli blows for a foul after Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
